title: Into the LAION's Den: Investigating Hate in Multimodal Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing alt-text descriptions in the LAION-400M and LAION-2B datasets using the pysentimiento NLP toolkit to calculate the Hate Content Rate (HCR), which measures the prevalence of hateful, targeted, and aggressive speech.
Deploying the pysentimiento hate speech analyzer, which is explicitly trained to detect misogyny, to identify and measure gender-targeted harmful speech in the dataset's image alt-texts.
Deploying the pysentimiento hate speech analyzer, which is explicitly trained to detect racism, to identify and measure racially-targeted harmful speech in the dataset's image alt-texts.
